hook: Two Oscars changed nothing until 7 years of waiting forced a total cinematic reset.

sections.voiceover: On October 12, 2026, NPR reported Mahershala Ali stars as Latif in Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother. Where did 7 years on Marvel project Blade go before this?

sections.voiceover: CultureCon revealed complex themes of Black fatherhood, but playing a killer raised the stakes.
Zetik reported that winning 2 Oscars left him fearless on set. Physical risks defined Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother.
